command: P="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/ml"; echo '=== REMOTE BRANCHES ==='; git -C "$P" for-each-ref --sort=-committerdate --format='%(refname:short)|%(objectname:short)|%(committerdate:iso8601)' refs/remotes/origin; echo '=== REMOTE MERGED INTO ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" branch -r --merged origin/main; echo '=== REMOTE UNMERGED INTO ORIGIN/MAIN ==='; git -C "$P" branch -r --no-merged origin/main
